<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>setAmount($amount)</code> : Set the amount of the transaction in Iraqi Dinar (IQD). The amount must be greater than or equal to the minimum amount specified in the configuration file.</li>
<li><code>setServiceType($serviceType)</code> : Set the service type for the transaction. The service type must be one of the following: <code>Book</code>, <code>Food</code>, <code>Grocery</code>, <code>Pharmacy</code>, <code>Transportation</code>, <code>Other</code>.</li>
<li><code>setOrderId($orderId)</code> : Set the order ID for the transaction. The order ID must be unique for each transaction.</li>
<li><code>setIsTest($isTest)</code> : Set the environment for using the ZainCash API. Set <code>true</code> for the test environment and <code>false</code> for the live environment.</li>
<li><code>setIsReturnArray(bool)</code> : Set the return type for the transaction. Set <code>true</code> to return an <strong>array</strong> and <code>false</code> to return an <strong>object stdClass</strong>. The default value is <code>false</code>.</li>
<li><code>createTransaction()</code> : Create a transaction and return the transaction Details (<strong>array</strong> or <strong>object stdClass</strong>).</li>
</ul>
